item.title: LAPD chases allegedly armed dirt bike rider
item.dc:creator: Danielle Smith
item.excerpt: Police are chasing a dirt bike rider in the South Los Angeles area on Wednesday evening.
item.description:
Los Angeles police are chasing a dirt bike rider believed to be armed in the South Los Angeles area on Wednesday evening.

The pursuit began near Dodger Stadium and continued on surface streets all the way to South LA.

At around 6:20 p.m., aerial footage from NewsChopper4 showed the rider stop to refuel before taking off with the gas pump. The rider was also seen on the wrong side of the road at times.

This is a developing story that will be updated as more information arrives.

item.title: El Segundo Art Walk is totally free and brimming with cool and fun diversions
item.dc:creator: Alysia Gray Painter
item.excerpt: Talk about a great summer-ender: Stroll around the community, take in galleries, and soak in uplifting works.
item.description:
What to Know

  • El Segundo Art Walk
  • Saturday, Aug. 22
  • 3 to 9 p.m.
  • Free

We’re not at the super-tight, up-against-the-end-of-summer conclusion of the hottest season, but the free art walk returns to the South Bay this weekend with galleries, live music, and food trucks along Main Street.

item.title: Chino Hills council reviews Peyton Drive repaving project timeline
item.dc:creator: Robert Kovacik
item.excerpt: Chino Hills council members reviewed an updated timeline for the Peyton Drive repaving project Tuesday night.
item.description:
The Chino Hills City Council reviewed an updated timeline for the long-delayed Peyton Drive repaving project during Tuesday night's meeting, with public works staff citing supply chain delays for the asphalt mix.

Council members pressed staff for a firm completion date after residents complained about pothole damage through the summer construction season.

A revised schedule is expected to come back to the council within 30 days, staff said.
